name: Maya
what: Project Maya: an inference server with its own engine, a dashboard and an API, built from source with CMake; a model loads at start, unloads through the API, and its context and thinking budget can be set while it runs.

can: start a unit from its launcher
load and unload through the API
set the context (the engine reloads) and the thinking budget
cannot: read the thinking budget back: the engine does not report it

update.note: The engine is compiled (build-maya.bat / build-maya-vision.bat, CMake). The check tells you when upstream moved; pull and rebuild by hand, then restart the unit. An owner with a reliable build step can override this with a script recipe.

all: build-maya.bat (Windows) or follow upstream's CMake steps
python maya.py --setup to fetch a model pack; a maya-<name>.json and run-maya-<name>.bat per model

good: one large model resident at long context with a settable context and thinking budget
vision when the model pack has it
not: a model without a Maya pack
